question: The Government of India, in February 2022, approved ₹26,275 crores for an umbrella scheme for the modernisation of the police force in India for the next how many years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**5.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Government of India, in February 2022, approved ₹26,275 crores for an umbrella scheme for the modernisation of the police force in India for the 5 years.**
 
• While the** United Nations recommended standard is 222 police per lakh persons.**
 
• **India's sanctioned strength is 181 police per lakh persons.**
 
• The actual police strength in **India is at 137 police per lakh persons.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Under the new policy, the existing 26 cadres have been divided into five zones **in the new policy by the Department of Personnel and Training of Government of India.
 
• According to a survey by IPF,** Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Assam, Kerala and Sikkim **are on top in the IPF Smart Policing Index 2021.
 
• **Lord Cornwallis** created a permanent police force in India.
